verification.caveat: Different size/grid CLI settings are explicit. Resource stop guards and timeouts differ; every selected run completed successfully. Wall times were measured on a shared host, not controlled performance tests.

report.limitations: Whole-process kernel peak RSS including startup and source nodes; not per-node allocation totals or GPU VRAM. Scalar RSS guards can miss localized growth hidden by fixed process overhead. Node completion does not establish numerical output correctness.
